root_cause: When a basket item is removed, the remove button loses its DOM attachment, causing focus to leave the trapped dialog and land on the body, breaking focus containment.
repair_strategy: After removing an item, if the basket dialog is still visible, move focus to the close button to retain keyboard focus inside the dialog.
expected_accessibility_effect: Focus remains inside the basket dialog after item removal, ensuring the #basket:focus-within assertion passes and preventing focus escape.
functional_risks: Alters expected focus behavior after item removal (focus moves to close button instead of staying at the removed button's position).
If the basket is hidden (unlikely during removal), focusing the close button may result in off‑screen focus, though it remains programmatically focused.
verification_requirements: After pressing Enter on the remove button for an item, the basket dialog must retain focus (assertion #basket:focus-within true).
The item count must update correctly (e.g., from 3 items to 2 items).
Keyboard navigation (Tab/Shift+Tab) should continue to cycle within the basket dialog and not escape to page elements behind the backdrop.
